subject: Geopolitics
title: Balance of Power Theory
description: One-minute skill: Balance of Power Theory.

hook.text: When Napoleon grew too strong, every other European power united to stop him. That pattern repeats endlessly.

buildup.text: Balance of power theory says nations form alliances to prevent any single state from dominating the system.

discovery.text: Alliances aren't about friendship. They're about survival. You join the weaker side to check the stronger.

twist.text: Sometimes nations bandwagon — joining the stronger side for gain. Small states often pick winners, not counterweights.

climax.text: US alliances in Asia exist because China is rising. Remove the threat and those alliances lose their glue.

punchline.text: Alliances are held together by fear, not friendship.

quiz.question: What does balance of power theory predict about alliances?
options: Nations ally based on shared culture and values
Nations form alliances to prevent any one state from dominating
Alliances are only formed after wars end
